# staticform_stripe_connection (Resource)

A Stripe payment connection, created from a restricted secret key (`rk_...`). Referenced by a form's `payment` block via its `id`. The label and key are immutable; the webhook secret can be updated in place.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Human-readable label.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Stripe restricted secret key (`rk_...`). Verified against Stripe on create; stored encrypted, never returned.

### Optional

- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Stripe webhook signing secret (`whsec_...`). Updatable in place; stored encrypted, never returned.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_mode` (String) `live` or `test`, derived from the secret key.
- `webhook_configured` (Boolean) Whether a webhook secret is set.
